resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Allocate Storage Quota and AI Quota per Studio, set the default policy and review resource increase requests. Allocation only, no purchasing.

stats.storageHint: Actual stored bytes across all Studios

configure.title: Configure Resource Allocation
configure.belowUsageWarning: The new quota is below current usage. Existing files are kept, but the Studio cannot store new data until it cleans up or the quota is raised.
configure.reasonHint: Recorded in the Audit Log with the old and new values.

policy.title: Default resource policy
policy.description: Applies to newly created Studios. Existing Studio quotas are not changed.
policy.notConfigured: No policy saved yet: showing system defaults. Save to fix the policy.
policy.warnHint: Studios at this level are flagged "Near limit".
policy.resetNote: AI Quota resets on the 1st of every month (UTC). Storage Quota does not reset.
policy.positiveHint: Every value must be greater than 0. To remove a limit, edit that studio directly.

requests.approveHint: Grants the requested amount by default; you can grant less. Approving applies the new quota now, notifies the Producer and writes the audit log.

validation.rejectNoteRequired: A reason is required to reject.
validation.positiveInt: Enter a whole number greater than 0.
validation.grantedAboveCurrent: The granted amount must be higher than the current quota.

reconcile.title: Storage reconciliation
reconcile.description: Scan file storage, recalculate each studio's usage from files still in use, and list orphan files. Scanning only reads; updating usage or deleting files needs confirmation.
reconcile.idle: Not scanned yet. Select "Scan storage" to see the numbers; this step only reads.
reconcile.unattributed: {count} files ({size}) belong to no existing studio.
reconcile.allMatch: Every studio's usage matches storage, and there are no orphan files.
reconcile.samplesTruncated: Only the first 200 files are shown.
reconcile.confirmDescription: {count} studios will get new usage based on files still in use.
reconcile.confirmNote: Orphan files stay in storage and are not deleted. Storage is scanned once more before saving; if a studio uploads during that time, run it again.
reconcile.deletedSkipped: Kept {recent} files newer than {days} days, {unattributed} files with no known studio, {referenced} files that were just reused.
reconcile.deletedFailed: {count} files failed to delete; run it again.
reconcile.deleteConfirmDescription: The report shows {count} orphan files that belong to studios. Deleted files cannot be recovered.
reconcile.deleteConfirmNote: Only files older than 7 days that belong to active studios are deleted. Files with no known studio, thumbnails, exports and all history records are kept. After deleting, select "Update usage" if recorded usage still differs.

uploadLimits.title: Upload file size limits
uploadLimits.description: Applies to every Studio from the next upload. Files already stored are not affected.
uploadLimits.notConfigured: Not saved yet: using server defaults (artwork 25 MB, reference images 10 MB, cover images 5 MB).
uploadLimits.artworkHint: Includes page images sent for panel detection. Up to {max} MB.
uploadLimits.referenceHint: Reference sheets and concept art. Up to {max} MB.
uploadLimits.coverHint: Series, chapter and Studio covers; Series avatar and banner. Up to {max} MB.
uploadLimits.range: Enter a size above 0 and no more than {max} MB.

health.title: System health
health.description: Probes the database, file storage and AI service, plus background work that is stuck or failing. Rechecks every minute while open.

reason.SERVICE_KEY_MISSING: The service is up but the backend has no AI service key, so every AI job will be rejected.

health.signalsDescription: Counted from the database at check time.
health.noSignals: The database could not be read, so background work was not counted.

aiRunsStuck.label: Stuck AI runs
aiRunsStuck.hint: Queued or running with no activity for over 15 minutes.

aiRunsFailed24h.label: AI runs failed in 24h
aiRunsFailed24h.hint: Multi-agent runs that ended with an error or were interrupted.

aiCallsFailed24h.hint: Provider error or no response. Quota limits are not counted.

exportsStuck.label: Stuck exports
exportsStuck.hint: Queued or rendering for over 30 minutes.
